name: getxattr
synopsis: ssize_t getxattr(const char *path, const char *name, void *value, size_t size);
ssize_t lgetxattr(const char *path, const char *name, void *value, size_t size);
ssize_t fgetxattr(int fd, const char *name, void *value, size_t size);
description: getxattr() retrieves the value of an extended attribute associated with a given file path. lgetxattr() performs the same operation but directly on symbolic links, while fgetxattr() uses an open file descriptor.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file or directory (for getxattr and lgetxattr)

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the open file (for fgetxattr)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the extended attribute to retrieve

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Buffer to store the attribute value

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer, or zero to get the attribute size

return_value.success: Returns a nonnegative value which is the size in bytes of the extended attribute value
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: The size of the attribute value is larger than the maximum size allowed
The named attribute does not exist, or the process has no access
Extended attributes are not supported by the filesystem
The size of the value buffer is too small
